proposals: The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish monthly ONORC portability transactions on IM-PDS, split into intra-state and inter-state, with origin and destination states and grain drawn, so the under-1 per cent inter-state share and state snapshots like Maharashtra's are dated, official figures.

The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish, each year, the difference between FCI's economic cost of rice and the OMSS(D) price on rice sold to distillers, multiplied by tonnage, so the gap this piece estimates at ₹9,000–10,000 crore appears as an official figure whatever it is called.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish each ethanol tender's allocation by feedstock alongside the NITI Aayog roadmap's planned split, so the gap between 28 per cent sugar-based allocation in ESY 2025–26 and the roughly 54 per cent the roadmap envisaged is tracked officially.

The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish the state-wise phase-in of the June 2026 broken-grain specification and the tonnes of broken rice actually freed each season, so the projected 8–9 million tonnes can be checked against what reaches distillers.

The Ministry of Cooperation should publish quarterly capacity completed under the cooperative-sector grain storage plan, by state and PACS, against the 700 lakh tonne target, so progress from roughly a quarter of one per cent is visible as it happens.
